SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
TUESDAY - JUNE 24, 2025 - 11:30 A.M.
SIERRA ROOM – CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE PERFORMING ARTS
18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CA 90703
Agenda Materials
The complete agenda for this meeting is available on-demand at cerritos.gov and at the Office of the City Clerk, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, 1st floor, Cerritos, CA, during regular business hours (Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., weekend and observed holidays excepted). Any materials submitted to the legislative body after distribution of this agenda will be available for public inspection in the Office of the City Clerk during regular business hours. Requests for agenda materials or meeting participation assistance can also be made by email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by phone at (562) 916-1248 during regular business hours.
Order of Agenda
The City Council, by majority of those members present, may reorder the business items listed on the agenda.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION
The public can observe the meeting in person in the Sierra Room at the Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts.
Public Comments
Members of the public may provide public comment for this meeting in person at the meeting or in writing as described below. Public comments are limited to items listed on this special meeting agenda only.
In-person public comment : Public comment on business agenda items will be opened and may be provided during consideration of that business agenda item.
Written public comment (hard copy or email) : Public comment may be submitted via email to city_clerk@cerritos.gov or by hard copy to the Office the City Clerk at 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703 no later than 5:00 p.m. on the day prior to the meeting. Please identify the agenda item number in the subject line of the email or hard copy document. All written correspondence received by the 5:00 p.m. deadline will be distributed to the legislative body prior to the meeting and retained with the official meeting record.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 916-1248 or at city_clerk@cerritos.gov in advance of the meeting to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the meeting.

The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution.
3.

PowerPoint
6.
Public Comments (Special Meeting Agenda Item 6)
Special meeting public comments are limited to Item 6 as listed on the special meeting agenda. Comments for this meeting will be limited to three minutes per speaker, subject to the Mayor extending to a maximum of five minutes per speaker, with a total time allotted not to exceed 45 minutes, unless the Mayor extends.
7.
Adjournment
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL HELD TUESDAY, JUNE
24, 2025, 11:30 AM, IN THE SIERRA ROOM AT THE CERRITOS CENTER FOR THE
PERFORMING ARTS, 18000 PARK PLAZA DRIVE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA.

 1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 11:55 a.m.

 2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Dustin Parker, Concordia Lutheran Church.

 3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Maddox Yokoyama.

 4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council were in attendance:

  Councilmember Jennifer Hong
  Councilmember Mark E. Pulido
  Councilmember Sophia M. Tse
  Mayor Pro Tem Lynda P. Johnson
  Mayor Frank Aurelio Yokoyama

 5.  State of the City Address

  Robert A. Lopez, City Manager, provided a brief introduction.

  Mayor Frank Aurelio Yokoyama delivered the State of the City address. A PowerPoint
  presentation was displayed.

  No action was taken on this item.

 6.  Public Comments (Special Meeting Agenda Item 5)

  At this juncture, the City Council, by consensus, ordered for continuance of this item
  to the next City Council meeting, scheduled for Thursday, June 26, 2025.

 7.  Adjournment

  The meeting adjourned at 1:20 p.m.

  /s/Cynthia Nava ______________________
  Cynthia Nava, City Clerk

 /s/Frank Aurelio Yokoyama____________
 Frank Aurelio Yokoyama, Mayor
